name: TaCZ Refabricated
description: A Fabric port of Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero (TACZ) for Minecraft 26.2, based on the official 1.2.0 release. Includes the full 1.2.0 feature set (scope lens effects, thermal imaging, rangefinder and fire-control displays, gun pegboards and display cases, ammo storage, ammo unloading, ADS presets, gun-pack filters, and JEI/REI queries), ported to the Minecraft 26.2 rendering and networking APIs. This is an unofficial migration of the official release and may contain unknown bugs; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the TACZ Dev Team.
contributors: TACZ Dev Team (upstream Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero)
